count_C[width(C)=4 and exists l in C: (C minus l) union {-l} in F] / count_C[width(C)=4]

r=PearsonCorr_{(v,C) in E}(d_v,k_C), where k_C=|vars(C)| and d_v=#clauses containing v. Return null for zero endpoint variance.
I(S;K)=sum_{s,k} p(s,k) log[p(s,k)/(p(s)p(k))] over literal occurrences, with K=min(clause_literal_count,9), S=positive/negative; normalize by H(S) when nonzero.
Let h_v and a_v count incidences of v in Horn and non-Horn clauses. f=sum_v min(h_v,a_v)/max(1,L).
q_uv=#clauses containing both u and v. B=sum_{u<v} choose(q_uv,2); f=B/max(1,sum_C choose(k_C,2)).
Peel all degree<2 vertices from the undirected incidence graph to a fixed point. f=#retained variable vertices/max(1,n).
For each variable v in an original component with N variable vertices, let s_i be variable counts in components after deleting v. f=max_v[((N-1)^2-sum_i s_i^2)/max(1,n^2)].
S=D^(-1/2) A D^(-1/2) on the unsigned incidence graph. f=tr(S^4)/max(1,n+m), estimated by mean_{8 fixed seeds} z^T S^4 z/(n+m) for Rademacher z.
On the deduplicated primal graph G_V, f=3*triangle_count/max(1,sum_v choose(deg_GV(v),2)).
Detect complete signed AND templates z<->(a and b), retain uniquely defined output variables. Let f_u=#retained gates using variable u as an input. f=sum_u max(0,f_u-1)/max(1,sum_u f_u).
Let O be uniquely defined gate outputs and T the set of defining clauses of retained gates. f=sum_{v in O} #incidences(v,C notin T)/max(1,sum_{v in O}d_v).

On the acyclic evaluable gate portion, primary inputs have CC0=CC1=1. AND literal z: CC0(z)=1+min(CC0(a),CC0(b)); CC1(z)=1+CC1(a)+CC1(b), swapping 0/1 for negated literals. f=mean[(CC1(v)-CC0(v))/(CC1(v)+CC0(v))] over defined outputs.

Initialize CO(v)=0 for recovered outputs used by residual constraints or with no gate consumer. For signed AND z<-a,b, candidate CO(a)=CO(z)+CC1(b)+1 and CO(b)=CO(z)+CC1(a)+1; take minima over consumers. f=mean(CO/(CO+CC0+CC1)) over finite defined outputs.
For each unambiguous gate cone expanded to two hops, collect signed ancestor literals. f=#cones containing both u and not-u for some ancestor / #fully expanded cones.

For a sampled support S with3..4 variables, evaluate conjunction of all clauses wholly contained in S. Count S if some variable is a total deterministic function of the rest (exactly one output value for every input row), excluding affine, AND/OR, majority, ITE and cardinality/exclusion relations. f=#qualified supports/#evaluated supports.

For each sampled nonconstant local satisfaction predicate on3..4 variables, recursively find a literal restriction making the predicate constant, continue on the other branch, and maximize chain length. f=mean(max_depth/arity).
For each nonconstant local predicate on3..4 variables, compute ANF coefficients by the Boolean Mobius transform; discard affine predicates. f=mean(max nonzero monomial degree/arity).

For non-tautological clauses with1<=k<=64, let P_k(j) be the observed clause-frequency distribution of j positive literals conditional on arity k; let p be positive literal fraction in this eligible population. f=sum_k P(k)*KL(P_k || Binomial(k,p)). Degenerate p=0/1 is defined by its exact limiting distribution.

For the fixed unsigned sample partition from S11, b_g=(positive-negative full-input literal incidences of sampled variables in community g)/literal_count_g. f=sum_g weight_g*(b_g-b_selected)^2, where b_selected is the mean over the sampled variable population.

For each of32 incidence edges u-v, form16 equal atoms approximating each lazy neighborhood measure:8 at the endpoint and8 seeded sampled neighbors. Solve the16x16 minimum-cost assignment with graph-distance costs in{0,1,2,3}. f=mean(1-W1).
On a <=96-variable induced primal sample, form its clique2-complex. beta1=E-V+components-rank_GF2(boundaries of all triangles); f=beta1/max(1,E).
For sampled distinct support pairs A,B, f=#(A intersect B nonempty and neither A subset B nor B subset A)/#sampled pairs.
For tested triples S of variable vertices, collect masks C intersect S. f=#triples realizing all eight masks/#tested triples.
For16 fixed balanced cuts of a <=128-node unsigned incidence sample, compute GF(2) rank of cross-cut adjacency; f=mean(rank/min(side_sizes)).
Run maximum cardinality search on a bounded induced primal sample. For each vertex test whether its later neighbors form a clique; f=violating vertices / eligible vertices.
For128 sampled connected quadruples, sort the three distance-pair sums a>=b>=c; delta=(a-b)/2. f=max(delta)/max(1,sample_diameter).
Count complete signed z<->MAJ(a,b,c) six-clause templates: (-a or -b or z),(-a or -c or z),(-b or -c or z),(a or b or -z),(a or c or -z),(b or c or -z). f=#covered output variables/n.
For each retained gate z<-a,b, check whether a,b have a common defined ancestor within two gate hops. f=#such gates/#eligible retained gates.
For retained signed AND templates z<->(a and b), f=(#z>0-#z<0)/#retained gates.
f=#variables with more than one distinct complete gate-definition signature/#variables with at least one complete definition.
Group unambiguous signed AND gates by normalized signed input pair; f=sum_classes max(0,class_size-1)/#retained_gates.
Q=sum_g[e_g/E-(vol_g/(2E))^2] for the unsigned bounded incidence sample partition from four fixed label-propagation sweeps.
Fit the slope d=-slope(log r,log N_cover(r)) for r=1,2,4 on a fixed bounded incidence neighborhood; N_cover is greedy radius-r ball cover.
f=#tested variable triples with at least three common clause neighbors / #tested triples; each success is an explicit K3,3 subgraph witness.
On a fixed <=96-variable induced primal sample, repeatedly remove the vertex with minimum fill-edge count; f=max live-neighbor count / max(1,sample_variables-1).

For fixed deletion rates q=0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1 on a <=128-node incidence sample, measure largest surviving variable-component fraction (zero if no survivors); average three seeds at interior q; f is the trapezoidal area on[0,1].
On a <=128-node incidence sample, compute Brandes betweenness for 16 fixed source vertices; f=max normalized internal-vertex dependency.
f=mean_{distinct connected sampled variable pairs}(1/d_incidence(u,v)); disconnected pairs contribute zero.
For up to32 sampled incidence edges e=(u,v), remove e and find d_{G-e}(u,v); f=mean(1/d), taking zero when disconnected.
Let x_0(u->v)=1 and x_{t+1}(u->v)=sum_{w in N(v),w!=u} x_t(v->w). f=sum x_3 / max(1,sum x_2).
Run GYO rules on sampled variable-support hyperedges: delete degree<=1 variables and contained support edges to a fixed point. f=remaining incidence mass / initial incidence mass.

Minimize sum_C choose(np_C,2) under variable sign flips. Starting with no flips, run12 coordinate passes in local first-appearance variable order; flip only on strict reduction. Divide final violated pairs by sum_C choose(width_C,2).

J_ij=sum_C 2^-width_C sign_i sign_j over distinct variable pairs. Start all spins+1;12 greedy coordinate sweeps minimize sum J_ij s_i s_j, flipping only on strict decrease. Return |J| mass with J_ij s_i s_j>0 divided by total |J|.
For the same raw J, return sum_{J_ij<0}|J_ij|/sum|J_ij|. No spin or gauge optimization.
Fraction of F* clause rows whose sorted all-literal negation also appears in F*. Duplicate rows remain in the fraction; an empty clause is its own complement.

Set each variable to its F* majority sign, ties true. Start S=all active variables; synchronously remove every S variable in any clause touched by S but unsatisfied by all S-assigned literals. At most128 passes; verify every remaining touched clause is satisfied. Return |S|/n.
Compute exact maximum clause-variable bipartite matching on F*. Return(m-matching_size)/m; empty clauses are unmatched rows, without adopting a SAT answer.

Greedily pack variable-disjoint clauses by(width,original clause ID). Greedily hit uncovered clauses by maximum uncovered occurrence, ties lowest original variable ID. Return(cover_size-packing_size)/m.
Use16 normalized sparse J power steps, starting x_i=sin(1.7*(i+1)). Let h_i=-sum_C sign_i2^-width_C. Return|dot(x,h)|/||h||, where x is unit norm.

Starting x=.5,64 projected subgradient steps minimize sum_C max(0,1-sum_l truth(l))+.05sum_i(x_i-.5)^2-h_i*x_i, h_i=(pos_i-neg_i)/degree_i. eta=.05/sqrt(t+1)/sqrt(maxdegree); clip[0,1]. Return mean(x-.5).

Uniform prior;12 synchronous OR-factor sweeps damped.5. Factor-to-variable log odds are sign(l)*[-log(1-product(other literal false probabilities))]; cavity excludes that factor. Clamp probability to[1e-9,1-1e-9] and log odds to[-20,20]. Return mean(2*p_i-1).
First64 F* rows; columns are exactly their variables,<=1024. Entries are literal signs. Gaussian partial pivoting with absolute1e-9 pivot threshold. Return1-rank/min(rows,columns).

Take first128 F* clauses of width<=8. Expand each U_C=2^-k product_l(1-sign(l)*z_v). Sum coefficients by variable subset with duplicate clauses retained. Return sum_{degree>=3} coefficient^2 / sum_{nonconstant} coefficient^2.

Stream F* canonical signed literals in original clause traversal order, renaming variables by first appearance, with0 delimiters. LZ78 phrase factorization counts a final unmatched prefix as a reference phrase. Return phrase_count*log2(max(2,phrase_count))/(tokens*log2(2*n+1)).
On the fixed LOCALcube, fraction of q-choose2 bit pairs with E(reference)-E(joint_flip)>0 while each individual gain<=0.
Exact BFS component of the majority reference using only hypercube edges whose endpoint energies both equal the reference energy. Return component_size/2^q.

Starting at the majority reference,128 steps: with probability1/16 choose a random bit; otherwise choose a minimum-energy neighbor, ties randomized. Always move even uphill. mt19937 seed0, decisions via integer modulo. Return1-unique_visited_states/129.
Using exactly the same129-state trajectory as RA16, among clauses touching the LOCALcube and violated at least once, return the fraction violated in all129 states.
All unordered F* clause pairs: P(U_C)=2^-k. Joint probability is0 on any shared opposite literal, otherwise2^-|union variables|. Return sum_pairs(joint-P_C*P_D)/sum_pairs(joint+P_C*P_D).
